title: Who has run and owned San Francisco nursing homes, edition by edition
question: Which San Francisco homes changed their registered operator or their owning organizations between 2019 and 2026?
finding: 3 of 21 San Francisco homes show more than one registered operator name across the December 2019 to October 2026 federal editions: Central Gardens Post Acute (Central Gardens, INC. / Golden California Healthcare, LLC); City View Post Acute (Ghc of San Fran 180, LLC / Pine Street Snf LLC); San Francisco Towers (Covia Communities / Front Porch Communities and Services).
how: For each home, the operator name in each edition (the operator-name field of the federal file), and the organizations (never people) listed as owners or managers with operational, managerial, direct or indirect ownership roles. Added and dropped compare the December 2019 edition with October 2026.
limits: A new operator name is often a change of operator, but can be a renaming or reorganization inside one group. Ownership rows list every layer of holding company, so counts rise when a group adds a layer. People who own homes are in the file but are not shown here.
